prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync Sign-In Reorder: Moves the sign_in step to after pet selection and certificate creation so users secure their custom pet instead of signing in up front. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in; placing auth right after pet creation makes clear that sign-in saves the newly chosen pet.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Assembly Live Animation Wait Screen: Transforms the waiting step into a full-bleed live animation showing pet rendering stages while files prepare. (why: The home/waiting step drops off 18.7% of users with an average wait time of 2336s; visual assembly cues maintain user attention during high latency.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop Visibility Sound Alert Notification: Enables sound notifications and ready alert cues on the waiting screen when rendering finishes. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets missing on screen or app failing to open visually; users tab away during long waits (mean 2336s) and miss pet arrival.)

scores.note: Moving sign-in after pet creation prevents lost pets cited in 8 support emails and protects adoption progress.
Full-bleed live animation keeps users engaged during the 2336s mean wait time, but requires building new UI screens.
Sound notifications address tabbed-away users during long rendering wait times, supported by 3 user support tickets.
